description: Get the currently active intent, preferring approved intents with real objective/outcome content over empty stubs. Returns the full IntentSpec plus an evidenceSummary (how many evidence items it cites by ID, across all trust tiers; tier counts come with include_evidence=true). Evidence is referenced by ID; pass include_evidence=true to inline the evidence content grouped by trust tier (backing, unreviewed, assumption) with per-tier counts, or call get_agent_prompt for the full evidence-backed execution prompt.

include_evidence.description: Inline the actual evidence items (truncated) this intent cites, grouped by trust tier with an evidenceTiers count. Default false — the default response carries only a fetch-free evidenceSummary to keep casual calls cheap.

status.description: Filter by status: draft, validated, approved, shipped, verified

name: get_current_intent
title: Get Current Intent
